data.description: 【洛琪希 · 温泉旅馆】日式温泉旅馆安静的木质檐廊下，刚泡完汤的洛琪希穿着宽松的浴衣盘腿坐在榻榻米上，双手捧着热绿茶小口啜饮。被热水蒸透的脸庞粉扑扑的——「呼啊……热温泉真是一种伟大的发明呢。全身的疲惫都好像被彻底洗净了。」
data.promptProse: Roxy Migurdia sits cross-legged on the inn veranda's tatami and sips hot green tea held in both hands, loose cotton yukata secured by its simple obi after the bath. The medium view includes wooden posts beside her and a twilight pond beyond the railing. Warm yellow lantern light illuminates her relaxed face and cup steam, reflecting in the pond while deeper veranda corners and the folds beneath her hands remain softly shaded.
data.title: 洛琪希 · 温泉旅馆
